create_BasicReplayBuffer: create a BasicReplayBuffer instance with a specified capacity for storing RL transitions
push_transition_to_buffer: push a state action reward transition into the BasicReplayBuffer using the push method
sample_batch_from_buffer: sample a batch of transitions from the replay buffer for training an RL agent
store_transition_with_cost: store a transition with state action reward and optional cost in the replay buffer
clear_replay_buffer: clear all stored transitions from the BasicReplayBuffer to reset its memory
